title: Reconcile ledger records with idempotent duplicate handling

behavior_contract.task_statement: Implement a deterministic ledger reconciler that validates CSV rows, applies exact duplicate transactions once, rejects conflicting duplicate transaction IDs without partial effects, and reports exact per-account and global totals.
invariants: Amounts are positive integers in minor units; binary floating-point is prohibited.
Exact duplicate rows are idempotent and count once.
A transaction ID reused with different data causes rejection before any side effects are committed.
Output account rows are ordered lexicographically by account ID.
Global credits, debits and net equal the sums over account rows.
Net equals credits minus debits with checked integer arithmetic.

negative_controls.notes: The baseline implementation cannot satisfy the contract.
Apply TX-002 twice and verify totals diverge.
Replace integer-minor-unit arithmetic with lossy numeric conversion.
Accept a transaction ID collision with different content.
Apply rows before detecting a later conflicting duplicate.

oracle_review.notes: Blueprint only; review and actual control runs are prerequisites for task admission.

evaluation_policy.notes: Not score-eligible until implementation, reference controls, test execution, and all evidence receipts are materialized.
